listing.name: Default Background Mod Bundle
listing.summary: 3 Mods. This mod bundle does not include any actual backgrounds, they just change the default background too one that already exist. The default background affects the background you see in the campaign, while at the main menu and in missions that do not have a preferred background specified.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the default campaign and menu backgrounds to existing game assets.
